description: Read a web page for an AI: fetch a public page and return its main content as clean, LLM-ready Markdown (navigation, footers, scripts and cookie banners removed) plus metadata: title, description, author, published/modified dates, canonical URL, language and word count. Reads server-rendered HTML (no JavaScript execution) and respects robots.txt.
name: read_url
title: Read a web page as Markdown
